subject: CXO seat rotation and demo parachute plan
messages:
From: Jordan Avery <jordan.avery@parallaxtech.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@parallaxtech.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Exec presence for Dec 28 demo?

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the ongoing conversations. We’re close on internal alignment and want to lock an executive-friendly demo for next week (targeting Tue or Wed, Dec 28–29). The ask from our CIO is that at least one CXO (VP product or CTO) attends the live demo for 30 minutes to cover roadmap alignment and security posture.

Quick context: we’ll have the engineering evaluation team for the technical deep dive, but the CIO wants to hear about reliability and runbook/ops guarantees from a senior sponsor.

Can you confirm who on your side can join for an executive intro + short Q&A? If flexibility helps, we can take the sponsor intro at the top or move it to the end as a 20–30 minute block.

Also attaching our internal priorities (attached).

Thanks — Jordan
Parallax Tech
[Attachment: parallax-priorities.xlsx (XLSX, 48 KB)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Avery <jordan.avery@parallaxtech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec presence for Dec 28 demo?

Hi Jordan —

Great to hear we’re nearing the finish line. I can cover the executive intro myself for a 20–30 minute window (LP-level sponsor). I’ll loop in Ben (sales) and Tessa (solutions) to coordinate logistics and the run-of-show.

Proposed approach:
- 12:00–12:45 PT: product demo + engineering Q&A (Ben/Tessa)
- 12:45–13:10 PT: executive intro (me) + high-level SLA/capacity cover and next steps

If the CIO prefers CTO-level detail, Marcus Lin (our CTO liaison) can join the sponsor intro as backup. Marcus is available but will need a calendar hold confirmed 24 hours in advance.

Attached is a short demo agenda we use for executive sessions — we keep the sponsor portion tight and focused on operational guarantees and escalation paths.

Next steps: if you can confirm preferred day/time (Dec 28 vs Dec 29) and whether the sponsor intro should be at the start or end, we’ll lock invites and a backup (parachute) plan.

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Field Solutions, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Avery <jordan.avery@parallaxtech.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@parallaxtech.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec presence for Dec 28 demo?

Lauren —

Thanks — quick operational note: if Marcus is on standby, let’s also nominate a 2nd-line fallback in case of overlap (holiday travel). I suggest Tessa run the runbook Q&A if Marcus drops, and I’ll own any procurement/next-step commitments in the follow-up.

Two more asks for Parallax before we lock:
1) Confirm CIO’s top two priorities for the sponsor segment (reliability SLOs, data isolation, cost/capacity).
2) Any procurement or procurement-neutrality stakeholders who should be looped into the invite (legal/procurement/infosec).

If Dec 28 works for you, I’ll send calendar holds for the group and mark Marcus as a conditional attendee.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Avery <jordan.avery@parallaxtech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@parallaxtech.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 14:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec presence for Dec 28 demo? — Confirmed and procurement note

Hi all —

Dec 28 12:00–13:10 PT works for the CIO and the engineering panel. Thanks for the clear run-of-show — we’d like the sponsor intro at 12:45 (end of demo) so the CIO can ask wrap-up questions after seeing the product.

Priority list for the sponsor segment: 1) operational SLAs and failure modes, 2) data retention and controls for dedicated/private deployments.

For procurement: I’m adding Thomas Green (procurement cc’d on this thread) — he’ll handle contract routing and will want a DMARC + SOC2 evidence packet ahead of any PO. If you can surface the standard SOC2 and deployment control artifacts or a pointer to where we can download them, that’ll speed procurement.

We also appreciate the parachute plan — please add Marcus as conditional and Tessa as fallback. Once you send the calendar invites, we’ll accept and route an internal agenda to the CIO.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Jordan
Parallax Tech
[Attachment: procurement-checklist.txt (TXT, 2 KB)]
